acceptance_criteria: Authenticate the exact B512 and S615 artifacts against the historical Seed 615 evaluation freeze and authenticate the Seed 636 selected-state manifest, external archive and sidecar, population member, and selected inventory SHA-256 6c6b1f680b2177cb67c79a9a642216703f160131034fbf8fe86e8130910ed077.
Evaluate exactly the 512 selected states, without replacement, filtering, or reweighting; independently recompute canonical and production-float32 identities and legal actions for every state.
Record deterministic legal-masked B512 and S615 probabilities for every legal action; reject nonfinite, negative, unnormalized, or illegal-action probability mass.
Reproduce top-action disagreement with the existing deterministic first-index tie rule and total-variation distance from the complete recorded probability vectors.

Apply the Seed 623 secondary subset contract exactly: sort by descending TV, cap at one state per continuation game and four per opening cluster, and resolve ties by SHA-256 of the frozen state ID; select 64 when available, reporting unavailable if fewer than 32 distinct source games qualify.

Report overall and per-stone-bin disagreement, TV distribution including quantiles and mean, fixed 1/5-per-bin standardized summaries, policy entropy differences, diagnostic subset coverage and cluster composition, and its relationship to the complete primary population.
Independent deterministic reproduction matches identities, legal masks, complete probability vectors, TV, disagreement classifications, summary calculations, and diagnostic subset membership exactly.
Retain exposure classification: known-exposure-screened; inherited P-E4 exposure unresolved. Interpret all findings as descriptive policy differences, not strength evidence.

No population regeneration, MCTS, exact solving, tablebase probes, training, evaluation games, or candidate promotion. Stop on authentication or verification failure; preserve evidence and do not retry automatically.
artifact_retention_class: Git report and small reproducibility outputs plus verified external archive of complete per-state inference evidence
execution_scope: B512/S615 deterministic legal-masked prior inference, descriptive policy comparison, and frozen secondary subset selection on exactly the authenticated 512-state Seed 636 population; no additional states or primary-population modification.
hypothesis: On the fixed, authenticated Seed 636 selected-state population, B512 and S615 produce descriptively measurable legal-masked policy differences that can be characterized without changing the primary population.
objective: Characterize B512/S615 policy prior differences on all 512 Seed 636 states and freeze the Seed 623 high-total-variation secondary diagnostic subset; all conclusions are descriptive and are not evidence of relative playing strength.
scientific_protocol: Seed 623 prospective exact-quality benchmark, section Secondary: prior-disagreement diagnostic; analyze only the frozen Seed 636 512-state cohort. Top-64 descending-TV selection, max one per continuation game, max four per opening, tie-break SHA-256 of frozen state ID; availability requires at least 32 distinct games.
stop_conditions: Stop before inference if any registered model, Seed 615 freeze, Seed 636 archive, sidecar, population member, manifest, or selected inventory identity fails authentication.
Stop if the authenticated cohort is not exactly 512 states or any recomputed identity, legal-action set, or provenance binding differs.
Stop on invalid probabilities, illegal-action mass, nondeterministic outputs, or any mismatch in independent reproduction; do not filter, replace, reweight, or retry states.
